course_name_en: Sales of Technical Products and Systems
prerequisites: Previous modules in which basic knowledge and communicative skills related to the respective topic area are fostered.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can classify the essential sub-areas of sales and their underlying scientific approaches within the technical context.
Students who have successfully completed this module possess basic knowledge in the field of "Technical Sales" and can explain application possibilities.
Students can reflect on sales methods and concepts with reference to existing technical requirements and conditions.
After successful completion of this module, students apply professional methods: identifying requirements and needs, product selection, pricing, formulating an offer, closing a contract.

Upon passing, students can present themselves/their company/their project/a product, give and receive feedback. They know questioning techniques for conducting conversations and can choose an influencing style appropriate to the situation. They can demonstrate that cooperative collaboration often leads to intensive exchange with customers.

assessment_rules: The graded assessment consists of a written examination and a presentation (with written elaboration). Both parts of the examination are weighted at 50% each and must be passed. The presentation should be approximately 5-10 pages and 20 minutes long. The written examination duration is in accordance with the currently valid study regulations.
